svg.title: PhytoScope Figure 1 A4 portrait
svg.desc: All text Arial Regular 7 pt; text and strokes pure black; strokes 0.5 pt; content within 25 mm page margins. All arrows and shafts are single path objects.

g.aria-label: PhytoScope: a portable local framework for plant genome queries
Public data, a shared locus model, and source-derived validation
One import and query code path across species
Source features and inferred intervals remain labelled
Save / reopen inputs, locus state and results
Expression example: three individual IC426787 biological replicates, 5 days post-anthesis.
d Independent public-data validation / seven plant species evaluated
5 coding loci in each of 3 plants
Span, spliced RNA and CDS hashes
Expression reads: IC426787; reference cultivar: VRB3. This supports import and ID compatibility.
Structure and sequence examples use LOC124833352; expression display uses LOC148191553.
